text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Head to... Tokyo 
Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the gist of it. An 
unidentified—and intense rejection 
response.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the exact truth, but... it's 
clear Admire Groove is in pain. If she 
keeps moving her body like this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have to go... To the place I finally 
found... where my feelings belong...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The very first step of that girl's racing 
career... No matter what it takes...
choice_data_list:
Then at least let me massage your 
shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No. I must go... with my own legs... by 
my own will...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I "promised."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's strange. We should be arriving 
right about now...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even when I send a message, it doesn't get 
marked as read. Didn't they say they were 
'coming to watch'?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes, though... they also mentioned not 
feeling very well. Apparently it's nothing 
too serious, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Alv-chan...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This is... Inside that bizarre world 
again...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's dark... endlessly dark and... 
heavy... Even so... I have to go...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—!? These clinging... voices... These 
visions... what on earth—

Even knowing it's unavoidable, it still 
hurts...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
What... What is this...!? What do you mean 
by that...!?

I'm sure she's watching over us from 
somewhere far away right now...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Watching over from... a distance...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me. I have to... 
bear witness to it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have... to go... Ngh...!!

It's unavoidable. It's unavoidable. It's 
unavoidable.

Unavoidable. Unavoidable. Unavoidable. 
Unavoidable. Unavoidable. Unavoidable. 
Unavoidable. Unavoidable. Unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (The light... is fading away...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Ah... Duramente-san... ...I...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's almost... time to head to the 
paddock...

text_block_list.name: School Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if they can't make it... I 
guess it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: School Staff B
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. If they're not feeling 
well... there's no obligation to push 
themselves to come...”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—No, Alv-chan will come. She definitely 
will!

text_block_list.name: School Staff A
text_block_list.text: Sensei...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That girl, you see... She coached 
Duramente more passionately than anyone 
else in the school.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Take the teachings passed down from Air 
Groove and properly make them your own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Without a deep passion, you wouldn't be 
able to coach with such fervor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if we haven't known each other long, 
she's already an indispensable presence to 
us.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You can feel it too, can't you? Yes, that 
girl is already our—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: They're just like family.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My family... Mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"So she'll come. There's no way she 
won't."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Let us wait. Just a little longer. For 
Alf-chan.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Alv...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Alv-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
"‘Alve-chan...’ ‘Alve...’ 
‘Alve-senpai...!’"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I hear... voices... I want to go... But I 
can't...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
People tied by destiny... I wonder if they 
were together from the very beginning in 
the past.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if things wouldn't have turned 
out this way if I had been there from the 
start this time too...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm sure it's the same...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't give it my all back then, and I 
can't give it my all now. In the end, 
history just repeats itself...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
But why do I keep on, time and time 
again...
Duramente! Hey, Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is... I've never heard anything 
like this before...

Duramente... no matter how you look at it, 
that's way too fast...
Just when things were about to begin...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
What was that just now...? Did she just... 
vanish...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If things stay as they were, not just me, 
but that girl too...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You searched for... a new path...? In 
order to change something from before...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If that path leads here, then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
This path... is right. Even if it is a 
heavy, painful road.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The problem is... whether I currently have 
the strength to walk all the way through 
this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: This... voice is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's right... this whole time, I've 
walked alongside this voice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the proposal for improving the 
training menu I asked for?
choice_data_list:
As requested, it's a high-load, 
high-density training menu

As requested, it's a high-load, 
high-density menu!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I had thought you might come up with a 
more conservative proposal, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even after I had polished myself to my 
absolute limit, that person forged me even 
further...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Who I am now is—a new me, supported by 
feelings I never had before...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If this rebirth was what was needed to 
tear off the shackles of fate—!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was having... a dream. A distant 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel... the pulse. The beat driving 
my limbs forward. ...I can do this.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Right now, I am—strong!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm fine now. Let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm... late.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Groove... -senpai! Groove...! 
Groove-chan...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: DAAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente takes 1st place! Living up to 
the overwhelming favoritism, she crosses 
the finish line in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It seemed out of reach, but what a sweep 
from the far outside! She showed off a 
magnificent burst of power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A circle of joy formed. The entire school 
packed into the stands was overjoyed with 
pure, uninhibited delight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From parent to child, from senior to 
junior. The teachings passed down through 
these strong bonds—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It has now been passed down to a new 
generation, marking a truly memorable 
day."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, were you watching? At long last... 
my dream of stepping onto the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to guide and instruct me 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's still quite unpolished. There is 
so much I still need to teach them.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You must straighten your posture and move 
forward. For you have—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The future of the school is on the line.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... It kind of sounds like something 
a teacher would say...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Duramente-san, next time, I'll be 
the one to show you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll run even better than before at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, transcending fate—the baton once 
again returns to the hands of Admire 
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To the Tenno Sho (Autumn), where Air 
Groove once achieved a historic victory.
